description: Implementation of SOCKS5 client socket handling SOCKS5 handshake, connection, read/write operations, and socket management within the Chromium net namespace.

classes.name: SOCKS5ClientSocket
classes.description: A class implementing a SOCKS5 protocol client socket, managing handshake, connection, and data transfer over a transport socket.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Initiates connection and SOCKS5 handshake process.

methods.name: Disconnect
methods.description: Closes the socket and resets internal state.

methods.name: IsConnected
methods.description: Checks if the socket is connected and handshake is complete.

methods.name: IsConnectedAndIdle
methods.description: Checks if the socket is connected and idle.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the socket after handshake completion.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the socket after handshake completion.
